programs.programName: Portugal D7 Passive Income & Retirement Residence Visa
programs.localLanguageName: Visto D7 - Residência por Rendimentos Próprios (Art. 58.º Lei 23/2007)
programs.eligibilitySummary: Non-EU nationals with stable, verifiable PASSIVE income (pensions, real estate rental, dividends, royalties) meeting means-of-subsistence criteria under Portaria n.º 1563/2007 based on the 2026 Portuguese minimum wage (€920/month). Correctly classified as Passive Income/Retirement (D8 is the separate Digital Nomad visa).
